description: Creates an Active Directory forest or domain trust relationship and validates Kerberos authentication across the trust boundary. Supports one-way and two-way trusts, external and forest trust types.

source_domain.label: Source Domain
source_domain.description: FQDN of the local domain establishing the trust

target_domain.label: Target Domain
target_domain.description: FQDN of the remote domain or forest to trust

target_domain_admin_user.label: Target Domain Admin User
target_domain_admin_user.description: Admin username on the target domain for trust negotiation

target_domain_admin_password.label: Target Domain Admin Password
target_domain_admin_password.description: Admin password on the target domain (stored encrypted)

dry_run.label: Dry Run
dry_run.description: Run connectivity preflight only — no trust created

rollback.description: Remove the trust relationship using Remove-ADTrust on both sides of the trust boundary.

steps.description: Verify DNS resolution and connectivity between source and target domains
Create the trust relationship via New-ADTrust or netdom
Validate Kerberos authentication across the trust boundary
